name: @tomiwu/activities-watch
description: Watches the apps of the after-school Activities and reports cancelled and moved classes to the Recipients on Telegram.

kody.description: Reports cancelled and moved after-school classes to the Recipients on Telegram.

SUPABASE_KEY.description: Key of the restricted Supabase role automations_watcher (sent as {{secret:SUPABASE_KEY}} to the Supabase project host).

TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN.description: Telegram bot token. The package passes only its name (secretName) to @tomiwu/telegram send-message, which sends it as {{secret:TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN}} to api.telegram.org for the Notifications.
